# Data preparation
penguins_mass_by_sex <- penguins |> 
  filter(!is.na(sex), !is.na(body_mass_g)) |>
  group_by(species, sex) |>
  summarize(
    mean_mass = mean(body_mass_g),
    .groups = "drop")

# Default ggplot
ggplot(
  penguins_mass_by_sex, 
  aes(x = species, y = mean_mass, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge")

ggplot(
  penguins_mass_by_sex, 
  aes(x = mean_mass, y = species, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6)

# Accessible, polished color palette (Custom Hex Colors)
color_female <- "#2b5c8f"  # Deep steel blue
color_male   <- "#d95f02"  # Warm burnt orange

ggplot(
  penguins_mass_by_sex, 
  aes(x = mean_mass, y = species, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("female" = color_female, 
                               "male" = color_male))

ggplot(
  penguins_mass_by_sex, 
  aes(x = mean_mass, y = species, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("female" = color_female, 
                               "male" = color_male)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    # Removed redundant 'species' and 'mean_mass' titles
    axis.title = element_blank()
  )
